t2.thesis: Resilient foot traffic data and positive sell-side checks support top-line and comp momentum, providing modest upside against reasonable forward valuation multiples.
reasons: Placer.ai traffic data and RBC commentary highlight potential comp upside driven by promotional cadence and digital engagement across Tim Hortons and Burger King.
Modest forward valuation at 16.7x forward P/E and a recent 5-day pre-earnings dip (-1.4%) alleviate extreme positioning risks.
Option skew shows favorable call IV over put IV at ATM (+3.9%), reflecting slight upside demand.
t2.deciding_variable: Same-store sales (comparable sales) growth across Burger King US and Tim Hortons relative to consensus expectations.

prior.from: consumer cluster base rate (n=436, hit rate 0.555)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved slightly up from 0.555 to 0.56 (+0.005) because positive cell-phone traffic data and positive analyst revisions are offset by historical 50% post-earnings win rate where beats frequently sold off.

theses.expected: Tim Hortons and Burger King deliver solid comparable sales beats driven by digital promotions and menu innovation.
theses.mechanism: Positive comp surprise drives operating leverage in high-margin franchisor royalty streams, leading to pre-market buying.
theses.wrong_if: U.S. consumer dining fatigue or negative traffic outweighs menu price increases.

theses.expected: Beef inflation and supply chain cost pressures compress franchisee unit economics, dampening forward guidance.
theses.mechanism: Margin commentary dampens investor appetite for restaurant franchisors, leading to a gap down.
theses.wrong_if: Supply chain segment revenue growth and cost pass-through successfully preserve consolidated margins.

theses.expected: International segment resilience and China JV restructuring stabilize non-US royalty growth.
theses.mechanism: Clarity on International performance and Carrols integration keeps segment EBITDA growth on track.
theses.wrong_if: International macro weakness in Europe or China leads to underperformance in overseas royalties.

key_observations: Consolidated and segment-level comparable sales growth (particularly TH and BK US)
System-wide sales growth constant currency vs Q2's 6.4%
Operating margins in supply chain and impact of beef cost inflation on franchisee health
Net restaurant count additions and progress on refranchising Carrols units
